title: Vietnamese Rainbow Trout
description: A flavorful and vibrant dish combining the delicacy of trout with the boldness of Vietnamese flavors.
instructions: 2. Rinse the trout fillets and pat them dry.
3. In a small bowl, mix together the Mi Quang Spice Blend, Vitamin E Oil, Dense Vietnamese Fish Sauce, and Emulsified Soy Sauce.
4. Brush the spice blend mixture evenly onto both sides of the trout fillets.
5. Place the trout fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Bake the trout in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
7. While the trout is baking, chop the fresh Rainbow Basil into small pieces.
8. Once the trout is cooked, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 2-3 minutes.
9. Serve the trout hot, garnished with chopped Rainbow Basil and a squeeze of lime juice.
10. Serve with additional lime wedges on the side.
